definitions.explanation: The side of something facing south, or the area to the south of a reference point. South-facing sides are valued in housing because they receive more sunlight.

examples.japanese: {南側|みなみがわ}の{部屋|へや}は{明|あか}るい。
examples.english: Rooms on the south side are bright.

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}の{南側|みなみがわ}に{庭|にわ}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: We made a garden on the south side of the house.

examples.japanese: {南側|みなみがわ}にベランダがあるマンションは{人気|にんき}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Apartments with a south-facing balcony are popular.

notes:
Compound of {南|みなみ} (south) + {側|がわ} (side). South-facing properties ({南向|みなみむ}き) are highly valued in Japanese real estate because they receive sunlight throughout the day.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南側|みなみがわ}の{窓|まど}: south-facing window
- {南側|みなみがわ}に{面|めん}する: to face south
- {駅|えき}の{南側|みなみがわ}: south side of the station
- {南側|みなみがわ}の{部屋|へや}: south-facing room

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {北側|きたがわ}: north side
- {東側|ひがしがわ}: east side
- {西側|にしがわ}: west side
- {南向|みなみむ}き: south-facing (as a property attribute)
